LanguageData.HE_Nord_Skyr.label: skyr bowl
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Skyr.description: A bowl of thick, sour skyr with berries and a drizzle of honey. Filling and good for the bones.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HunterStew.label: hunter's stew
LanguageData.HE_Nord_HunterStew.description: Venison, roots and barley simmered all day in an iron pot over the long fire. It keeps a hall warm through the dark months.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Flatbread.label: honey flatbread
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Flatbread.description: Thin barley bread baked on a stone and spread with honey and butter, served with mead at every feast. A small treat: eating it is a little joy.
